name: Shin'yaku In'youchuu - Shiro Neko Honpo Hen & Tsukishiro Shimai Hen
original_name: 新訳 淫妖蟲 白猫本舗編＆月白姉妹編
source:
Three short stories related to Shinyaku In'youchuu and set around the same period of time.

The White Cat Brigade route tells the story of how Sora joined the group and her first mission as demon hunter.

The Hagio sisters route tells the story of how Ai became the way she is seen in In'youchuu Goku.

The Tsukishiro sisters route sees them in a brief encounter against some demons.
